newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Q2 1996 GDP unchanged from Q2 1995.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Q2 1996 GDP unchanged from Q2 1995.

text.p: Hungary's total economic output was practically unchanged in the second quarter of 1996 from the same period in 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Monday.
"According to preliminary estimates the overall performance of the economy remained practically unchanged from the same period last year," KSH said in a statement.
NOTE - This was the second time that KSH released preliminary GDP figures.

KSH gave no absolute figures. However, according to preliminary figures recently published by the Finance Ministry, Hungary's GDP totalled 5,500.00 billion forints in 1995, while the 1996 target is 6,610.00 billion forints.
